notes.title: Save file transfer to release version
notes.notes:
Maxwell's puzzling demon is out in 48 hours!
For those who enjoyed the demo, here is how to transfer your demo save file to release version.
You need to follow the procedure below as the game doesn't automatically transfer the save file. 
[olist]
  [*]Open the folder C:/Users/<User name>/AppData/Local/maxwells_puzzling_demon/save/<SteamID>, where your save file is located.
  [*]Make a copy of [b]progress_demo[/b].save and rename it [b]progress[/b].save.
[/olist]
You can prepare this before the release version is out, so that you can start your game right after its release.
